name: Trung Xi Nhat Nham
role: Interpreter at Núi Bà Đen; Larry says a warrior monk
summary: A man Larry names in VN-0148, standing at the burnt-out helicopter on Núi Bà Đen. In Larry's words: "He was protecting me. He was an interpreter and could speak 9 languages. He was a warrior monk." New to the archive on 2026-09-02, and the only person Larry has ever described as assigned to his protection.
researchNotes: The rendering is his son's transcription of what Larry says, not a spelling Larry gave letter by letter, so it should be treated as a record of a sound rather than of an orthography. A reading of the name that bears directly on how it should be searched is filed in research/people/trung-xi-nhat-nham.md and is deliberately not repeated here, because a question to Larry about this man is still worth asking cold. Nine languages is an unusually specific claim and a searchable one: interpreters of that calibre at a Special Forces site were few, and the combination with a religious vocation is rarer still. Núi Bà Đen was a pilgrimage mountain with an active temple complex on its slopes, which makes the description internally coherent rather than surprising. Nothing documentary has been sought yet.
